feature: ADR-0104 immutable staged rule selection and next-stage main action planning
abi: Pure Rust shared rule selector/planner and private Engine Arc signatures; no unsafe/FFI/dependency/ABI changes, oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Shared engine/selection/planner changed; native Windows compilation and prior validations pending approval quota issue.

limitations: Trusted immutable validated config and condition evaluator must observe one consistent generating event state. Selection is not native lease/activation/owner/source/binding admission.
Main-to eligibility is frozen once; other held/alone/after-up/delayed branches require fresh filtering at their own generating event.
First-match even when all to actions filtered out. Unknown never matches. Concrete modifier side selection retained without re-evaluation after variable assignments.
plan_main produces Simple-to-Complex or Complex-to-Output only, preserving old Arc/source/device/options/duration/input-up recipe. Caller must reserve ownership, enqueue and retain saved bindings.
Private stable iterator preflight reuses original action-plan checks without cloning entire action/condition arrays; no new hard allocator/lookup/condition-time bound.
Complete deferred stage actor/extra branches and native duration/simultaneous remain unfinished; existing native Engine UnsupportedActionTiming gate retained.
Deterministic synthetic tests and existing no-input process harnesses only, no actual global input/devices/native duration/driver/install operations.
Windows adapters/native tests, full context/hotplug/UI/packaging/driver and original scope remain unfinished.
